provides: The backend half of the analytics standard: an ingest endpoint for @stapel/analytics batches with an event registry and a PII guard, server-side track() for modules, a comm bridge from business Actions, funnels and event reports over the core event store, adapter fan-out, last-touch click attribution, offline click-conversion upload, and GDPR erasure of the event stream.

curated.summary: What happens to an event name the registry does not declare: warn (store it and mark it, the default), reject (refuse the batch) or off.
Off by default. On: an ingest batch without a recognised write key is refused with 401, so only configured sources can write analytics.
curated.business_label: Only keyed sources may send events

curated.summary: Ships reject: a property value that looks like personal data refuses the event. strip removes the value, warn stores it and logs, off disables the guard.
Days an analytics event is kept before the purge drops it (400 by default); None keeps events forever, which a deployment states rather than drifts into.
On by default: recorded events are announced as analytics.events.recorded and delivered to the configured adapters. Off: events are stored only.

extension_points.name: EVENTS
extension_points.summary: The event vocabulary this deployment admits ({name: definition | None}, merged over EVENTS_FILE and runtime register_event()); None removes an entry.

extension_points.name: ADAPTERS
extension_points.summary: Fan-out targets for recorded events ({name: spec | None}, merged over the built-ins and runtime register_adapter()).

extension_points.name: COMM_BRIDGE
extension_points.summary: {action_name: event_name | spec}: turn a business comm Action (payment.completed, ...) into an analytics event without code in the emitting module.

extension_points.name: PII_GUARD
extension_points.summary: The PII heuristic callable(value) -> bool, same contract as the frontend guard. Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: SUBJECT_RESOLVER
extension_points.summary: Which id a funnel groups one event row by (user hash, else anonymous id, else session id). Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: INGEST_AUTHENTICATION
extension_points.summary: Authenticator classes for the ingest view only.

surface.name: guard_props
surface.intent: Apply the PII mode to an event's props: return them cleaned, or raise in reject mode. Every path that stores props goes through it.

surface.name: hash_user_id
surface.intent: The subject key of a person (sha256 of salt + user id) — the same key the frontend facade computes, so funnels join and erasure finds the rows.

surface.name: looks_like_pii
surface.intent: The default PII heuristic for one value (swappable through PII_GUARD); reuse it rather than writing a second guard that disagrees.

surface.name: pii_mode
surface.intent: The effective PII_MODE (reject|strip|warn|off) — read it through this, not the setting.

surface.name: check_write_key
surface.intent: Resolve an ingest body's source from its write key, refusing an unrecognised key when REQUIRE_WRITE_KEY is on — the gate a custom ingest path calls before recording.

surface.name: delete_funnel
surface.intent: Delete an authored funnel (declared ones are refused by the view).

surface.name: purge_events
surface.intent: Drop analytics events past the retention horizon and return how many — what the purge task and command run.

surface.name: record_batch
surface.intent: Record one ingest body (registry check, PII guard, clock correction) and return the receipt; the single write path behind POST /events.

surface.name: save_funnel
surface.intent: Create or update a funnel row after validating the whole rule; the write path the API and a project's seed share.

surface.name: track
surface.intent: Record ONE server-side event from a module — the in-process twin of the analytics.track Function, so a server funnel step lands in the same stream as the browser's.

surface.name: validate_steps
surface.intent: Refuse a funnel whose steps can never be reached before it is saved.

requires.reason: the event store the events live in, the comm bus (Functions, the bridge, fan-out Actions), GDPR owner registration, AppSettings, JWT auth and the error envelope
